stem.text: In one of the first experiments to demonstrate the Doppler effect, a train was filled with trumpeters all playing a note of frequency $440\,\text{Hz}$. The difference in observed frequency of the note as the train directly approached a stationary observer was $22\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of sound was $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
At which speed was the train moving?
